channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Kohala sends Kauka out with another Division II championship
item.description: Layden Kauka scored 16 of his 28 points in the first half as Kohala opened a 20-point lead en route to a 49-35 win over defending state champion Seabury Hall for the Division II boys basketball state title on Friday night.

item.title: ’Bows face Cal State Northridge men’s basketball on the road
item.description: Following Thursday’s road victory over Cal State Bakersfield, the Hawaii men’s basketball team was on the road again, making the 96-mile bus ride to Northridge, Calif.

item.title: Moanalua’s Millare wins Gatorade cross country honor
item.description: Moanalua’s James Millare was named the Gatorade Hawaii Boys Cross Country Player of the Year for the second consecutive time on Friday.

item.title: U.S. military preparing for potentially weeks-long Iran operations
item.description: WASHINGTON >> The U.S. military is preparing for the possibility of sustained, weeks-long operations against Iran if President Donald Trump orders an attack, two U.S. officials told Reuters, in what could become a far more serious conflict than previously seen between the countries.

item.title: Unstoppable Jordan Stolz blazes to 500m crown for 2nd Milan gold
item.description: MILAN, Italy >> American speed skating phenomenon Jordan Stolz once again stole the spotlight today, rocketing to the men’s 500 metres title at the Winter Olympics and securing his second gold medal of these Games.

item.title: Investigators focus on car, residence near Nancy Guthrie’s home
item.description: Investigators searching for answers in the disappearance of Nancy Guthrie descended on two locations near her home overnight, as they continue to sift through the thousands of potential leads that have arrived since she vanished Feb. 1.

item.title: National Weather Service issues wind advisory for Hawaii
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued a wind advisory for most Hawaiian islands starting Sunday morning.

item.title: No. 3 Hawaii in championship form with another sweep of No. 18 Stanford
item.description: Kainoa Wade put down a match-high 15 kills and hit a career-best .737 to lead the third-ranked Hawaii men’s volleyball team to a 25-17, 25-16, 25-13 sweep of No. 18 Stanford today at Maples Pavilion in Stanford, Calif.

item.title: CSUN thumps Hawaii in men’s basketball
item.description: Larry Hughes II scored 27 points and point guard Josiah Davis added 20 points and five assists to power Cal State Northridge to an 84-60 victory over Hawaii today at Premier America Credit Union Arena on the CSUN campus.

item.title: Hawaii uses big second half to turn away Cal State Northridge
item.description: Imani Perez scored a season-high 18 points with three blocks and the Hawaii women’s basketball team dominated the second half to defeat Cal State Northridge 63-54 tonight.
